basic_details.job_title: NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 24 Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli (NIT Tiruchirappalli) Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 24th July 2026 on the official website of the institute. A total of 24 vacancies have been announced through the NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 for Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainee posts.

qualification.details: For Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees: Graduate/Diploma holders

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Tiruchirappalli to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Apprentice Trainee posts at NIT Tiruchirappalli is 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for the Apprentice Trainee posts under the NIT Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026. This includes both Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Apprentice Trainee posts at NIT Tiruchirappalli is online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Apprentice Trainee at NIT Tiruchirappalli?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Apprentice Trainee position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate or Diploma qualification from a recognized institution to be eligible for the Apprentice Trainee posts.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Tiruchirappalli Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Apprentice Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Apprentice Trainee posts at NIT Tiruchirappalli involves an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Apprentice Trainee posts is Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, at the National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NIT Tiruchirappalli?
faq.answer: The official website for National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is www.nitt.edu, where candidates can find more details and apply.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: The Apprentice Trainee positions at NIT Tiruchirappalli are contractual job types, offering valuable experience in a government setup.
